drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel:
Counsel,

Please find attached our initial draft of the Confidential Settlement Agreement. The draft reflects a payment-for-release structure, with payment conditioned on execution and followed by dismissal with prejudice. We have also included customary confidentiality, no-admission, tax, and non-disparagement provisions.

Please let us know if you have any comments, and we can work to finalize promptly.

Best,
Aldous Finch LLP

edits.name: Scrub document properties and internal notes

edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Within ten (10) business days after Plaintiff delivers to Defendant a fully executed copy of this Agreement and a completed IRS Form W-9, Defendant shall pay Plaintiff the total settlement amount of $[●] (the “Settlement Amount”) by wire transfer or other mutually agreed method. Payment is conditioned upon Plaintiff’s execution of this Agreement and shall not be due unless and until this Agreement is fully executed.
edits.name: Payment timing and conditions

edits.text: 2. RELEASE. Upon receipt of cleared funds for the Settlement Amount, Plaintiff, on behalf of Plaintiff and Plaintiff’s heirs, representatives, agents, attorneys, successors, and assigns, fully and forever releases and discharges Defendant and its current and former parents, subsidiaries, affiliates, officers, directors, employees, agents, insurers, attorneys, successors, and assigns from any and all claims, demands, causes of action, liabilities, damages, fees, costs, and expenses of any kind, whether known or unknown, suspected or unsuspected, arising out of or relating to the facts, transactions, occurrences, claims, counterclaims, or matters alleged or that could have been alleged in the dispute between the Parties through the Effective Date.
edits.name: Broaden release

edits.text: 3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The Parties shall keep the existence, terms, and amount of this settlement strictly confidential and shall not disclose them to any person or entity except: (a) to the Parties’ attorneys, accountants, tax advisors, insurers, auditors, or financial advisors who have a legitimate need to know and are informed of the confidential nature of the information; (b) to the extent required by law, subpoena, court order, or governmental authority; or (c) as necessary to enforce this Agreement. If disclosure is required by law or process, the disclosing Party shall, to the extent legally permitted, provide prompt written notice to the other Party and reasonably cooperate in seeking confidential treatment.
edits.name: Confidentiality exceptions and notice

edits.text: 4. NO ADMISSION. This Agreement, the payment of the Settlement Amount, and any related negotiations are a compromise of disputed claims and shall not be construed as an admission of liability, wrongdoing, fault, damages, or the validity of any claim or defense by Defendant, all of which are expressly denied.
edits.name: Strengthen no admission

edits.text: 5. DISMISSAL. Within five (5) business days after receipt of cleared funds for the Settlement Amount, Plaintiff shall file, or cause to be filed, a dismissal with prejudice of all claims against Defendant, with each Party to bear its own attorneys’ fees and costs except as otherwise expressly provided in this Agreement.
edits.name: Add dismissal with prejudice

edits.text: 6. NON-DISPARAGEMENT. Plaintiff shall not make or publish any false, disparaging, or derogatory statement regarding Defendant or its officers, directors, employees, products, services, or business practices, except in truthful testimony or statements required by law.
edits.name: Add non-disparagement

edits.text: 7. TAX MATTERS. Plaintiff is solely responsible for any federal, state, local, or other taxes, interest, penalties, or reporting obligations arising from or relating to the Settlement Amount. Defendant makes no representation regarding the tax treatment of any payment under this Agreement.
edits.name: Add tax allocation

edits.text: 8. AUTHORITY; ENTIRE AGREEMENT. Each person signing this Agreement represents that the person has authority to bind the Party on whose behalf the person signs. This Agreement constitutes the entire agreement between the Parties concerning its subject matter and supersedes all prior or contemporaneous understandings, negotiations, or agreements, whether written or oral. This Agreement may be amended only in a writing signed by all Parties.
edits.name: Add authority and integration

edits.text: 9. GOVERNING LAW; COUNTERPARTS. This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of [●], without regard to conflict-of-law principles. The Agreement may be executed in counterparts and by electronic signature, each of which shall be deemed an original and all of which together shall constitute one instrument.
edits.name: Add governing law and counterparts

edits.text: 3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The Parties shall keep the existence, terms, and amount of this settlement strictly confidential and shall not disclose them to any person or entity except: (a) to a Party’s spouse or immediate family members, provided they are informed of the confidential nature of the information; (b) to the Parties’ attorneys, accountants, tax advisors, insurers, auditors, financial advisors, or other professional advisors who have a legitimate need to know and are informed of the confidential nature of the information; (c) to the extent required by law, subpoena, court order, governmental authority, tax reporting obligation, or other legally required reporting; or (d) as necessary to enforce this Agreement. If disclosure is required by law or process, the disclosing Party shall, to the extent legally permitted, provide prompt written notice to the other Party and reasonably cooperate in seeking confidential treatment.
edits.name: Mutual confidentiality with permitted disclosures

edits.text:
4. MUTUAL NON-DISPARAGEMENT. The Parties agree that they shall not make, publish, or communicate to any person or entity any knowingly false or disparaging statement concerning the other Party or, in Defendant’s case, its current or former parents, subsidiaries, affiliates, officers, directors, employees, agents, attorneys, or business operations. This provision does not restrict truthful statements made in response to legal process, to governmental authorities, in connection with enforcement of this Agreement, or as otherwise required or protected by law.

5. DISMISSAL. Within three (3) business days after Plaintiff’s receipt of cleared funds for the Settlement Amount, Plaintiff shall execute and file, or cause to be filed, a dismissal with prejudice of the action and any pending claims covered by this Agreement, with each Party to bear its own attorneys’ fees and costs except as otherwise expressly provided in this Agreement. No dismissal shall be required before Plaintiff’s receipt of cleared funds.

6. NO ADMISSION OF LIABILITY. This Agreement is a compromise of disputed claims. Nothing in this Agreement, nor any payment made pursuant to it, shall constitute or be construed as an admission of liability, wrongdoing, or violation of law by any Party, all of which are expressly denied.

7. AUTHORITY; TAXES. Each person signing this Agreement represents that such person has full authority to execute and bind the Party on whose behalf the person signs. Plaintiff acknowledges that Plaintiff is solely responsible for any taxes, interest, penalties, or reporting obligations arising from the Settlement Amount, and Defendant makes no representation regarding the tax treatment of the Settlement Amount.

8. ENTIRE AGREEMENT; SEVERABILITY. This Agreement constitutes the entire agreement between the Parties concerning the subject matter hereof and supersedes all prior or contemporaneous negotiations, discussions, and agreements concerning that subject matter. This Agreement may be amended only in a writing signed by all Parties. If any provision is held invalid or unenforceable, the remaining provisions shall remain in full force and effect to the maximum extent permitted by law.

9. GOVERNING LAW; COUNTERPARTS. This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of [●], without regard to conflict-of-law principles. The Agreement may be executed in counterparts and by electronic signature, each of which shall be deemed an original and all of which together shall constitute one instrument.
